news.analysis: Williams contributed well on Sunday. He was able to churn out 56 yards and a touchdown on the ground, but he wasn't able to contribute much in the passing game, which hurt his fantasy total. He should continue to be a good fantasy asset moving forward, though the increasing involvement of Blake Corum isn't what fantasy managers want to see.

The stud wideout hauled in 10 of his 11 targets for 155 yards and two touchdowns during the overtime victory. He snagged an 18-yard touchdown to help tie up the game with less than two minutes left in the fourth quarter. news.analysis: Nacua had a great game from a fantasy perspective on Sunday. He led the team in targets, receiving yards, and receiving touchdowns in a win over the Chargers, which left him with a terrific fantasy total. He remains a must-start option in all league formats moving forward, which should go without saying at this point.
